title: pseudopipturus repandus
intro: Pseudopipturus repandus, commonly known as the Philippine Pepper, is a type of flowering plant in the family Piperaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions.
